sections.heading: Description
sections.content: The Case for Change is a summary that explains the current situation (problem and urgency for change), the future state and the required steps to get there. It provides a common baseline of awareness and understanding among stakeholders and serves as a basis for further communications. A clear 'What's In It For Me' (WIIFM) is defined for each key stakeholder group.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Creates a shared understanding of why change is necessary. Enhances stakeholder buy-in and commitment. Reduces resistance by clarifying the value of transformation. Supports strategic alignment across the organization. Enables focused and purposeful change execution.
